track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 6: Chaharpareh
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Chaharpareh in Abu-Ata, Mahur. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ak3 and dwells most on E in Chaharpareh. The line peaks at B4 (499.1 Hz) at 0:53.3. It closes on B4, not the tonic (A3 → A3 → E3 → E3 → E3 → B4).
